verdicts.reason: A keeps the pink '48H ONLY' badge at a readable size and gives the headline and CTA a clear left-to-right order. Its flaws: the badge circle is cropped at the top and bottom, it crowds the shoebox, and the subcopy is tiny and set off to one side. B shrinks the badge into an unreadable pink smudge after the subcopy, and the oversized headline nearly runs into the CTA pill, leaving no gutter.

A's headline jams against the CTA pill and its '48H ONLY' badge is an illegible sliver next to the subcopy. B spaces the headline, subcopy and CTA better, but its tiny badge overlaps the corner of the shoebox. B also has a strip of stripes showing under the green panel along the bottom edge, which looks like a rendering error. Both are flawed; B's collision and glitch tip it slightly lower.
